ui.guide.topic.1.line.1: The public editor at / does not require a login.
ui.guide.topic.1.line.2: Use Room Layout on the Home Ribbon to choose one, two, three, or four bedrooms, or a blank plan. The Building tab has the same option.
ui.guide.topic.1.line.3: Changing the layout can replace your existing design. Confirm the prompt and save a version or JSON backup first.
ui.guide.topic.1.line.4: Use Building → House Dimensions / Blank Layout to configure the size of a new house.
ui.guide.topic.1.title: Getting started and room layouts
ui.guide.topic.10.line.1: Open Advanced Interior Design → 3D / Materials to select Translate, Rotate, or Scale Gizmo.
ui.guide.topic.10.line.2: Choose render quality, Day/Evening/Night lighting, wall color, and furniture color.
ui.guide.topic.10.line.3: Select a room in 2D or 3D before applying its floor finish; select furniture before changing its color.
ui.guide.topic.10.title: Advanced interior design: 3D, materials, and lighting
ui.guide.topic.11.line.1: Open Advanced Interior Design → Plans / Versions, enter a name, and save the current design.
ui.guide.topic.11.line.2: Compare versions to review differences in rooms, furniture, and estimated cost.
ui.guide.topic.11.line.3: Restore or delete a version; consider backing up your current design first.
ui.guide.topic.11.title: Advanced interior design: plan versions
ui.guide.topic.12.line.1: Open Advanced Interior Design → Estimate / Export to inspect floor area, example unit prices, and the contingency rate.
ui.guide.topic.12.line.2: Export estimates as CSV, an HTML design report (print to PDF), or the plan as JSON.
ui.guide.topic.12.line.3: If the administrator disables exports, the built-in export actions are unavailable. Editing and importing remain available.
ui.guide.topic.12.title: Material estimates and document exports
ui.guide.topic.13.line.1: Use the editor at / without signing in.
ui.guide.topic.13.line.2: An administrator signs in at /login using a username, password, and image CAPTCHA.
ui.guide.topic.13.line.3: If Google Authenticator is enabled, enter the six-digit code after the first step; otherwise sign-in completes immediately.
ui.guide.topic.13.line.4: In /admin, administrators can toggle Google two-step verification and public export permissions.
ui.guide.topic.13.title: Public editor and administration
ui.guide.topic.14.line.1: Use Tutorial Settings at the top right to enable or disable the automatic first-use walkthrough.
ui.guide.topic.14.line.2: Even with automatic guidance disabled, you can replay the tutorial from the User Guide or settings.
ui.guide.topic.14.line.3: This preference is stored only in the current browser’s localStorage.
ui.guide.topic.14.title: Tutorial preferences
ui.guide.topic.2.line.1: Go to Edit → Draw Wall and click the start and end points. Hold Shift to constrain horizontally or vertically.
ui.guide.topic.2.line.2: Use Move Wall to drag an entire wall segment; select a wall and choose Split Wall to divide it at its midpoint.
ui.guide.topic.2.line.3: Wall ends snap to nearby walls, and T- or cross-junctions can be split automatically. Existing doors and windows restrict some changes.
ui.guide.topic.2.title: 2D selection and wall drawing
ui.guide.topic.3.line.1: Choose a door or architectural window from the furniture library and place it near a wall.
ui.guide.topic.3.line.2: Use Snap to Nearest Wall to align an item; horizontal, vertical, and angled walls are supported.
ui.guide.topic.3.line.3: A door or window must fit within the available wall segment. Hinged doors show their opening state in 3D.
ui.guide.topic.3.title: Doors and architectural windows
ui.guide.topic.4.line.1: Choose a furniture category and add an item. Use 3D Preview on a card to inspect its model.
ui.guide.topic.4.line.2: You can move, resize, rotate, duplicate, or delete an item and adjust its layer.
ui.guide.topic.4.line.3: Alignment guides appear near other items. Toggle Smart Snapping under Building.
ui.guide.topic.4.title: Furniture and 3D preview
ui.guide.topic.5.line.1: Enable Collision Alerts on the Building tab.
ui.guide.topic.5.line.2: When you select or drag furniture, red indicates overlap and orange indicates insufficient clearance.
ui.guide.topic.5.line.3: The general 600 mm warning is a design aid, not a legal standard for every space.
ui.guide.topic.5.title: Collisions and safe clearance
ui.guide.topic.6.line.1: Select one furniture item, then hold Shift while selecting others.
ui.guide.topic.6.line.2: Under Furniture, align left, center, right, top, or bottom, or distribute items horizontally or vertically.
ui.guide.topic.6.line.3: Choose Group to move or rotate items together; choose Ungroup to select them individually.
ui.guide.topic.6.line.4: Custom Angle opens a dialog that accepts signed and decimal degree values.
ui.guide.topic.6.title: Multi-select, align, and group
ui.guide.topic.7.line.1: Click Import / Manage GLB Models in the furniture library.
ui.guide.topic.7.line.2: Select a .glb file, enter a model name and dimensions, and find it under My 3D Models.
ui.guide.topic.7.line.3: Model files are stored in this browser’s IndexedDB; they are not automatically synchronized to Cloudflare Pages or other computers.
ui.guide.topic.7.title: Import custom GLB models
ui.guide.topic.8.line.1: Use View → 3D Scene. Switch between orbit and walk modes as needed.
ui.guide.topic.8.line.2: Choose full-height or cutaway walls, top or isometric view, and lighting conditions.
ui.guide.topic.8.title: 3D viewing
ui.guide.topic.9.line.1: Use File → Export Project JSON to back up your design, or import a JSON file to restore it. Exports require administrator authorization.
ui.guide.topic.9.line.2: Export floor-plan images and construction drawings as PNG files.
ui.guide.topic.9.line.3: Press Ctrl+Z to undo; Undo and Redo are also available from the Home tab.
ui.guide.topic.9.title: Save, export, and undo
ui.guide.tour.1.description: Use the Home, Edit, Building, Furniture, View, and File tabs in the Ribbon to access different tools.
ui.guide.tour.1.title: Feature tabs
ui.guide.tour.10.description: Export the plan as JSON and import it later to restore your design. Custom GLB files remain in browser IndexedDB and must be transferred separately.
ui.guide.tour.10.title: Save and import designs
ui.guide.tour.11.description: Search the User Guide from the top right. In Tutorial Settings, disable the first-use tutorial or replay it anytime.
ui.guide.tour.11.title: Open the User Guide anytime
ui.guide.tour.2.description: Choose a one-, two-, three-, or four-bedroom layout, or start with a blank plan. The editor confirms before replacing your layout.
ui.guide.tour.2.title: Switch room layouts from Home
ui.guide.tour.3.description: Open Building and select House Dimensions / Blank Layout to set the width and length of a new plan.
ui.guide.tour.3.title: Set house dimensions
ui.guide.tour.4.description: Select Draw Wall and click two points on the 2D canvas. Hold Shift to constrain the direction. Nearby wall ends snap automatically.
ui.guide.tour.4.title: Draw and edit walls
ui.guide.tour.5.description: Expand a category in the furniture library and click an item to add it. Use 3D Preview to inspect its model first.
ui.guide.tour.5.title: Place furniture
ui.guide.tour.6.description: Hold Shift and select multiple furniture items, then use Align Left, Center, or Distribute to arrange them.
ui.guide.tour.6.title: Multi-select and align
ui.guide.tour.7.description: Rotate selected furniture or enter a custom angle. Group multiple items to move, rotate, or duplicate them together.
ui.guide.tour.7.title: Rotate and group
ui.guide.tour.8.description: Use Smart Snapping to align objects to walls. Collision warnings highlight overlaps and insufficient clearances without blocking placement.
ui.guide.tour.8.title: Smart snapping and collision warnings
ui.guide.tour.9.description: Switch between the floor plan and 3D scene. Rotate the camera and inspect walls, doors, windows, and furniture.
ui.guide.tour.9.title: Switch between 2D and 3D
ui.guide.tour.title: Guided Tour
